item.title: Ghost hunters to investigate one of city's most haunted buildings
item.description: Shadow Hunters UK are calling for help to investigate Cinema City in The Suckling House, a Grade I building they believed to be haunted.

item.title: Plans revealed to restore 'lost river' through countryside
item.description: A restoration project hopes to bring back a lost stream in the countryside outside Bungay.

item.title: The city's planning bids which stirred a fuss this year
item.description: In a year full of planning applications to develop and improve Norwich, not all of the proposals were met with approval.

item.title: Officials say huge advert on the side of a distinctive building must come down
item.description: Officials have said a huge advert on the side of a distinctive building on the way into the will have to come down.

item.title: Man's hopes for an extended garden quashed by planning inspectorate
item.description: The planning inspectorate has refused a Costessey man's appeal to change the use of his farmland into a garden near the River Tud.

item.title: Roadworks to cause almost three months of disruption on busy Norwich street
item.description: Norwich drivers are facing eleven weeks of disruption in the new year because of a £300,000 project to revamp a set of traffic lights.

item.title: 'Road to nowhere' leaves villagers baffled as new highway leads to cliff edge
item.description: Villagers in Sidestrand on the north Norfolk coast have been left baffled over a 'road to nowhere' after Norfolk County Council agreed to register a byway track that leads to the cliff edge.

item.title: A lookback 100 years at life in Norfolk and Norwich
item.description: As we “look forward” to 2026 and consider what may happenduring the next 12 months let’s turn the clocks back 100 years.

item.title: Caravan owners fear they are being 'pushed out' of Norfolk parks following takeover
item.description: Caravan owners at two Norfolk holiday parks say they are being forced out by rising costs, changing rules and threats of eviction.

item.title: Finding holiday happiness (and lots of late 2025 sunshine)
item.description: Nigel Pickover found holiday happiness on a cruise through the Mediterranean and Aegean seas.
